title: 121 Castlemoyne, Balgriffin, Dublin 13, D13VY67
description:
LWK are delighted to present 121 Castlemoyne, an exceptional 5-bedroom semi-detached family home to the open market.  This stunning property in turnkey condition has been meticulously maintained and thoughtfully enhanced, resulting in a home of superior quality.  Ideally located in the much sought after Shannon Home built development, this luxury home is just minutes from the villages of Kinsealy, Portmarnock, Malahide and Howth and is sure to appeal to first-time buyers, families and professionals alike.  
Upon arrival. No. 121 makes an immediate impression. The beautiful red brick exterior with paved driveway is framed by mature border planting and comes complete with EV charging point, CCTV and a side entrance.
The stylish interior, immediately evident upon entry consists of bright and spacious living accommodation extending to 173 square meters / 1,861 square feet over 3 floors. The beautiful dual aspect living room with bay window, seamlessly connects to a light filled open plan dining/kitchen area, opening onto the sun-drenched south-facing patio to the rear. 

The light-filled kitchen features an excellent range of built in wall and floor units, complemented by a new kitchen island & matching splashback, sky lighting and integrated appliances.  There is a separate utility room and a guest WC in the hall. The fabulous, landscaped rear patio area provides an ideal setting for al fresco dining and comes complete with a serviced, insulated Garden Room with many uses.

Upstairs the first floor comprises 4 rooms and the family bathroom - currently in use as two double rooms -one en-suite- and two offices.  Bathrooms are all finished to the highest spec, with rooms providing ample storage. The amazing master suite on the second floor is sure to impress with built-in storage, a walk-in wardrobe and a luxurious en-suite bathroom.

•	Luxury 5-bed home in turnkey condition 
•	Spacious 173 square meters / 1,861 square feet
•	Convenient - sought after location
•	BER Rating B2
•	Stunning Landscaped patio area with Garden room 

Castlemoyne is a modern residential development located in the suburb of Balgriffin, North Dublin. This area has become increasingly popular among families and professionals alike, largely due to its balance between urban convenience and suburban tranquillity.  It offers easy access to the city and a range of local amenities while maintaining a peaceful, family-friendly environment.

Castlemoyne benefits from excellent transport links. The development is well-connected to Dublin city and surrounding areas via major roadways like the M50 and M1 motorways, offering quick and convenient access to the city centre, Dublin Airport, and beyond. Public transport is also readily available, with several Dublin Bus routes serving the area. Additionally, the Clongriffin DART station is nearby, providing a direct and efficient route into the city, making commuting hassle-free. 

For families, Castlemoyne is located close to several highly regarded schools. The area offers a range of both primary and secondary schools, catering to various educational needs. Nearby primary schools include St. Francis of Assisi Primary School in Belmayne and Scoil Naomh Colmcille in Donaghmede, both of which have strong reputations for academic achievement. For older students, secondary schools such as St. Mary's Secondary School in Baldoyle and Portmarnock Community School are easily accessible, offering excellent educational opportunities. 

Early viewing is highly recommended.
